title: Delayed Property Papers? Get ₹5,000/Day from Lender
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) mandates lenders to return original property documents within 30 days of loan repayment. This rule applies to personal loans, .

faq.q: Which loans are covered under this RBI directive?
faq.a: The directive applies to all personal loans where Regulated Entities (REs) hold original movable or immovable property documents as collateral. This includes home loans, loans against property, education loans, and consumer credit.

faq.q: When does the 30-day period for document return begin?
faq.a: The 30-day period begins after the full repayment and settlement of the loan account. This includes not just the final payment but also the completion of all loan closure formalities.

faq.q: What if the bank claims my documents are lost?
faq.a: If your original documents are lost or damaged while in the lender's custody, they must assist you in obtaining duplicate/certified copies and bear all associated costs. An additional 30 days (total 60 days) is given for this process before the ₹5,000/day compensation applies.

faq.q: Can I claim more than ₹5,000 per day?
faq.a: The ₹5,000 per day compensation is a mandatory minimum from the lender for delays attributable to them. This compensation is without prejudice to the borrower's right to seek any additional compensation under applicable laws, such as through consumer courts.

faq.q: Does this rule apply to Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) with loans in India?
faq.a: Yes, the RBI directive applies to all personal loans disbursed by Regulated Entities in India, irrespective of the borrower's residency status, as long as the loan falls under the specified categories.

faq.q: What if the delay is due to reasons outside the bank's control?
faq.a: The compensation is applicable only if the delay is "attributable to the Regulated Entity." If the delay is due to reasons beyond the lender's control, such as a natural calamity or a borrower's non-cooperation, the compensation might not apply. The lender must communicate the reasons for delay to the borrower.

based_on.title: Home loan repaid but lender didn’t return property papers? You can get ₹5,000/day compensation
